description: This file defines the class 'BesselY' for calculating Bessel functions of the second kind. It includes methods for evaluating the functions for given input values, handling edge cases, and supporting array inputs. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library's calculation engine, specifically within the engineering calculations module.

classes.name: BesselY
classes.description: Provides static methods to evaluate the Bessel function of the second kind, supporting array inputs and special cases.

methods.name: BESSELY
methods.description: Main method to evaluate the BesselY function, handling both scalar and array inputs, validating arguments, and managing error conditions.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Dispatches calculation to specialized methods based on order value, including special cases for orders 0 and 1.

methods.name: callBesselJ
methods.description: Calls the external BesselJ function to compute the Bessel function of the first kind, used internally for calculations.

methods.name: besselY0
methods.description: Computes the Bessel function of the second kind of order zero, using approximations for different ranges of x.

methods.name: besselY1
methods.description: Computes the Bessel function of the second kind of order one, with approximations for different x ranges.

methods.name: besselY2
methods.description: Computes the Bessel function of the second kind for higher order n > 1 using recurrence relations.
